title: PySegment: open-source PET/CT and SPECT/CT workstation for segmentation, radiomics, registration and radionuclide dosimetry
description: PySegment is an open-source, offline desktop workstation for quantitative PET/CT and SPECT/CT. It combines manual and semi-automatic segmentation, multi-reader studies, ROI measurements, IBSI-compliant radiomics, rigid, affine and deformable registration and radionuclide dosimetry in one program. Every module that produces a number is validated against public reference data (IBSI, QIBA, POPI, ICRP 107).
